Below is the complete changelog:

[b][u]ART[/u][/b]
[list][*]We added 4 new artworks to each [b]Neko Girl[/b] and 4 to the [b]Pussycat Gang[/b], totalizing 24 new artworks! You will unlock them by playing the [b]Levels[/b] in the [b]Photobook[/b].[/list]

[b][u]PUZZLE[/u][/b]
[list][*]To each new artwork, we have a new [b]Level[/b] in the game! So, we have 24 new [b]Levels[/b] in total! You can access them in the [b]Photobook[/b].
[*]We removed the transparent effect used in the puzzle pieces.[/list]

[b][u]PHOTOBOOK[/u][/b]
[list][*]We implemented the 24 [b]Pussycat Feast Levels[/b] in the [b]Photobook[/b].
[*]We also added cute cats in the [b]Pussycat Feast[/b] pages of the [b]Photobook[/b].[/list]

[b][u]DARKROOM[/u][/b]
[list][*]We implemented a [b]Film Button[/b] to cycle through the artworks from the base game and the ones from the [b]Pussycat Feast[/b].[/list]

[b][u]QUALITY OF LIFE[/u][/b]
[list][*]Now you can navigate in the [b]Photobook[/b] and in the [b]Darkroom[/b] using [b]A[/b] or [b]<[/b] to go Left and [b]D[/b] or [b]>[/b] to go Right.[/list]

[b][u]ACHIEVEMENTS[/u][/b]
[list][*]We had to rework several Achievs to suit Steam's policies.
[*]We also added the Achievs related to the new [b]Puzzles[/b] but old owners will have almost all of them already unlocked due to how we implemented them.[/list]

[b][u]THE HANDJOB ARTIFICER ART PACK[/u][/b]
[list][*]We added 37 artworks to the pack. It now contains 117 files![/list]
